audience.text: Developers building .NET applications on Windows, Linux, or macOS who need to generate or manipulate Excel-compatible workbooks and PDF reports without requiring Microsoft Excel.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks or load existing .xlsx files via Workbook constructors, navigate worksheets through Worksheets collection, and write values, formulas, and styles to cells.
capabilities.title: Create and edit workbooks

capabilities.text: Set fonts, fills, borders, alignment, and number formats using Style, Font, Borders, and FillPattern types, with StyleFlag controlling which properties are applied.
capabilities.title: Apply cell formatting

capabilities.text: Define validation rules with ValidationCollection and Validation types, and apply conditional formatting via ConditionalFormattingCollection and FormatCondition.
capabilities.title: Add data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Export worksheets to PDF using PdfSaveOptions, with page geometry controlled by PageSetup including paper size and orientation.
capabilities.title: Export to PDF

capabilities.text: Build structured Excel tables using ListObject and configure totals aggregation, and create charts using ChartCollection and Chart types.
capabilities.title: Support structured tables and charts

capabilities.text: Set worksheet-level display and print options including zoom, gridlines, right-to-left layout, visibility, and page setup via PageSetup.
capabilities.title: Configure page layout and print settings

limitations.text: Load support is limited to XLSX files; legacy formats like XLS, ODS, and CSV are not loaded.
Save support covers only XLSX and PDF; image and HTML export are not supported.
The library does not parse, evaluate, or recalculate formulas; Cell.Formula stores the formula as a string only.
No VBA or macro support; macro-enabled workbooks round-trip only non-macro content.
Pivot tables are not part of the public API surface.
No print execution; PageSetup configures print settings for spreadsheet applications but does not send workbooks to a printer.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and modification of Excel workbooks in server-side or containerized .NET environments without installing Microsoft Excel.
Supports robust loading of malformed XLSX files with repair diagnostics and optional recovery, preventing outright failures.
Provides worksheet-level formatting, styling, and layout control for consistent report generation and export to PDF.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells.FOSS is a free, open-source .NET library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks and exporting to PDF, with no dependency on Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported public symbols beyond those listed in public_symbol facts is not fully enumerated.
Whether the library supports loading or saving CSV, ODS, or other formats beyond XLSX and PDF is not confirmed by public_symbol or example facts.
The behavior of formula evaluation or recalculation when saving a workbook with formulas is not explicitly stated in example or public_symbol facts.

workflows.name: Create and format a workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a new Workbook, add data to Cells, apply Style with Font, Borders, and FillPattern, and save to .xlsx.

workflows.name: Load and repair a workbook
workflows.text: Load a workbook using LoadOptions with TryRepairPackage and TryRepairXml enabled, inspect LoadDiagnostics for repairs or data loss risk, then save the repaired file.

workflows.name: Export to PDF
workflows.text: Configure PageSetup for paper size and orientation, then save the workbook to PDF using PdfSaveOptions with OnePagePerSheet.
